prereg.honest_guard: no fix is keyed to the literal Rung-6 error sentences -- bug1 reuses the EXISTING IRREGULAR_VERB_LEMMA table wholesale (Rung 5), bug2/3 is a single general capitalization-based head-selection rule verified on 2 doc-cited + 4 genuinely novel nonce cases + 1 regression guard, imperative handling verified on 2 real corpus rows + 1 contract-canonical nonce + an explicit declared residual (see bug_fix_evidence.declared_residual_detail).
